title: Asset-Class Ladder (Jacob's Ladder of Assets) -- ALC-1
description: A governed, total and ordered asset-class ontology that grounds the estate omnirisk `asset_class` axis in the real economy, from tangible extraction (rung 0) up to pure digital services (rung 8). It REPLACES the thin {credit,equity,market,crypto} asset_class enum with the full value-transformation ladder and supplies economic-prophet's value-genesis: labor-mixing (rung 2) and extraction (rungs 1/1') are where Revenue originates before it is a financial claim. Every rung carries all structuring axes (tangibility, rivalry, renewability, labor_content, value_stage, process_regime) and binds a valuation_model plus a risk_F_family that the RM-1 risk kernel can consume. Measurement, simulation and audit only.

replaces_enum.description: The thin asset_class enum this ladder supersedes.

value_stage.description: The ordered rung index (value-transformation stage). Strictly increasing tangible -> digital.

rung_label.description: Human ladder label, e.g. '1' for the renewable-harvest sibling of the extractive rung.

tangibility.description: Physical embodiment of the asset. Monotone non-increasing along value_stage.

rivalry.description: Rival goods are consumed by use; non-rival goods (data/tokens/software/IP/digital services) are not.

renewability.description: depleting_stock = a finite stock that only diminishes when drawn; regenerating_flow = a biological/producible flow with a sustainable yield; non_physical = a claim/service/digital asset with no physical stock.

process_regime.description: The stochastic process regime the renewability axis induces. Crosswalk (enforced by the checker): depleting_stock <-> monotone_absorbing (drift toward an absorbing barrier at zero reserves; Hotelling), regenerating_flow <-> mean_reverting_ou (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck reversion to a sustainable yield; TC-1 persistence), non_physical <-> non_physical.

labor_content.description: Lockean labor-mixing intensity (labor + capital + know-how) embodied in the asset class.

valuation_model.description: The value-genesis model the EP kernel consumes for this rung.

risk_F_family.description: The RM-1 risk kernel that scores this rung's loss distribution F. Must be a known RM-1 kernel.

risk_F_note.description: Free-text description of the loss distribution F the kernel is applied to (e.g. reflexive fat-tailed return).
